Loss report: drone -> gitlab
[lost] pipeline/drone/job/ci/step/build step.image (GitLab sets the image per job, not per step)
[external] pipeline/drone/job/ci/step/build step.env: create deploy_token as a masked CI/CD variable in the project settings, protected too for protected branches (a GitLab file cannot mark a secret as one; it writes deploy_token as plain variable references and the operator sets the values there)
